checks.name: Footprint overlaps (buildings, walls, towers, fences, masts, pads' structures)
Nothing built on a road, lane, footpath or rail corridor
Every door has a clear apron of the right depth, paved and connected (heavy 26m, std 12m, dead-end 18m, person 3m)
Lane widths and curve radii (heavy convoy: low-loader R >= 15m)
Swept path of the low-loader through every junction turn (R 15m, body + off-tracking)
Rail: no level crossings with roads or footpaths, gantry clearance >= 6.5m
Turrets: never over a road / door, clear field of fire (no structure masking), overlapping coverage
Helipads: FATO + safety clear, approach / departure surface 4:1 for 150m clear of every obstacle
Explosive + fuel safety distances (magazines: inhabited 50m, ops 30m, traverse if < 30m; fuel: inhabited 25m, ops 15m, ignition 25m)
Pipe racks / cable trays: road clearance >= 6.5m, person >= 3.0m, spans <= 18.0m, never through a building it does not serve
Perimeter: berm -> fence -> kill zone >= 30m -> wall; roads cross only at gates; towers <= 55m apart, gates flanked
Traffic flow: one-way hazard spine, every door reachable, no reversing in the hazard zone, zones meet only at the wash
Interior: every room on the corridor network through its blast door, zones meet only at checkpoints, >= 3.0m rock cover
Terrain: everything built stands on the graded platform cut into the mountain (nothing overlaps rock)
Airfield: stands / taxiways / FATOs / drone station on the deck, clear and connected; every parked craft fully ON its stand or pad
Turret doctrine: corners alike, every gate flanked by a matching pair, north / south walls mirrored, sponsons alike, galleries typed by level, summit AD symmetric
